title: Bluelight Client Plus
description: The performance of Bluelight Client with added utilities!
body:
# Bluelight Client Plus ## Production **Provided by:** J0T0S0
**Loader:** Fabric
**Type:** client-side vanilla optimization modpack, with utilities that are not in the base [Bluelight Client](https://modrinth.com/modpack/bluelight-client) ## Overview Bluelight Client Plus builds on the foundation of Bluelight Client by combining high-performance optimization with a carefully selected set of essential quality-of-life features. It keeps the same goal of delivering smooth, responsive gameplay, but relaxes the strict “performance-only” philosophy to include a few lightweight utilities that improve usability without compromising performance. The result is a balanced experience:
vanilla-feeling gameplay, significantly improved performance, and a small set of practical tools. ## Why Choose Bluelight Client? ### Maximum FPS Gains Carefully selected optimization mods that target rendering, memory usage, and CPU efficiency. ### Essential Utilities Included Adds lightweight, commonly used features such as: - Minimap for navigation - Basic HUD enhancements - Small quality-of-life improvements ### Lightweight & Stable Minimal overhead ensures fast startup times and consistent performance across a wide range of systems. ### Multiplayer Friendly Fully client-side, does not interfere with the server in any way. ## FAQ **What’s the difference between Bluelight Client and Bluelight Client Plus?** Bluelight Client → Strictly performance-only
Bluelight Client Plus → Performance + essential utilities Does this affect performance compared to the base version? Impact is minimal. All included utilities are selected to remain lightweight and efficient. ## Join the community Join our official Discord server to stay updated on our products! --- ## Need A Server? Support The Project! Running a smooth client is only half the equation, your server matters too!
